text.text: Run a training business from one page. Clients, their packages and payments are linked, every training session is a Session row, and your own sessions show under Mine. The Packages table shows what is selling and how many clients stay.
What you sell, the price and how many clients are on each.
Everyone you train, with their package, attendance and payments.
Training sessions on the calendar, with attendance and notes.
Charges, failed cards and refunds, tied to each client.
Sessions this week, payments and package health.
Packages run out quietly. Renew before the last session, not after.
When a client has two sessions left, send a short message about next steps.
Offer the next package at the end of the second to last session.
Mark the old payment Paid and add the new one as Pending.
Offer a smaller package or a monthly plan. Never discount twice.
The first hour sets the plan and the relationship.
Review the intake form before they arrive.
Do a simple movement assessment and record it on the session note.
End with a clear plan for the next four weeks.
Say what you do not do
Be clear you do not diagnose or treat injuries. Suggest they see a health professional for any pain or condition.
Protect your time without losing the client.
Cancel with 24 hours notice at no charge
The first late cancel is forgiven
Message the client the same day.
